metadata.title: Project Delivery Manager
metadata.description: A lightweight workspace for delivery teams.

login.title: Sign in to the workspace
login.description: Use your account to enter the app shell. Organization, space, and capability boundaries come from the backend session.

form.title: Sign in
form.description: Successful sign-in opens the app shell.

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Registration opens the app shell immediately. If no organization is available, onboarding is shown.

form.description: Username and password validation reuse the shared contract.

preference.dd: Language and theme persist after sign-in

username.label: Username
username.error: Enter a 3 to 32 character username with letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

password.label: Password
password.error: Enter a password with at least 8 characters.

confirmPassword.label: Confirm password
confirmPassword.error: Confirm that both passwords match and are at least 8 characters.

name.label: Organization name
name.error: Enter an organization name up to 120 characters.

code.label: Organization code
code.error: Use 2 to 32 characters with letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.

api.BAD_REQUEST: The request is invalid. Check the input and try again.
api.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
api.FORBIDDEN: Your account cannot perform this action.
api.CONFLICT: The data already exists or conflicts with the current state.
api.VALIDATION_ERROR: The submitted content did not pass validation.
api.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is incorrect.
api.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
api.ORGANIZATION_ACCESS_DENIED: Your account cannot access this organization.
api.SPACE_ACCESS_DENIED: Your account cannot access this space.
api.SPACE_MEMBER_MUST_BELONG_TO_ORGANIZATION: The space member must belong to the organization first.
api.LAST_ORGANIZATION_OWNER_REQUIRED: The organization must keep at least one owner.
api.WORKFLOW_VERSION_ALREADY_PUBLISHED: The workflow version has already been published.
api.TARGET_REQUIRED_FOR_ATTACHMENT: An attachment must be linked to a target.
api.DRAFT_REQUIREMENT_REQUIRED: Only draft requirements can be processed.
api.INTAKE_ITEM_NOT_ACCEPTED: The intake item has not been accepted.
api.INTAKE_ITEM_ALREADY_CONVERTED: The intake item has already been converted.
api.UNKNOWN: The operation failed. Try again later.
